newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Nestle, Danone Czech unit Cokoladovny plan dividend.
newsitem.headline: Nestle, Danone Czech unit Cokoladovny plan dividend.

text.p: Czech confectioner Cokoladovny a.s., majority owned by a consortium of Swiss Nestle SA and France's Danone, said on Thursday it would propose shareholders to pay out a 70 crown gross dividend per share on 1996 earnings, after 50 crowns in the previous year.
The Swiss-French consortium Cokoladovny Partners hold an 81 percent stake in the Czech company.
Cokoladovny posted net profit of 735 million crowns in 1996, after 516 million in 1995.
The firm holds its annual general meeting on June 31, dividends will be paid to shareholders registered on June 23.
